analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 36.7 entering oversold territory, halting decline from 61.2 five days ago. CCI at -161.0 shows rebound from extreme oversold. 5-day low of $110.60 matches 20-day low of $110.60, forming a Higher Low pattern. Current price $113.28 is -6.75% below SMA200 at $121.48, but attempting rebound after oversold entry.
